<p class="lead">

VirMarkDB is a curated reference database of viral marker-gene sequences for <strong>*Nucleocytoviricota*</strong> within <strong>*Bamfordvirae*</strong>. It provides protein and nucleotide FASTA files, HMM profiles, and tool-compatible exports for taxonomic assignment, marker-based phylogeny and marker detection workflows.
</p>
